title: Gatebraid Slice metadata (gatebraid/slice@1)
description: Machine-readable block in a Slice issue body: a '## gatebraid-metadata' heading followed by exactly one fenced yaml block; parsers take the first such fence under that heading. Structure per report 12 §9, schema id renamed per ADR-0010. The workflow profile id 'classic' is a stable identifier, not a former name.

slice_id.description: e.g. P1-S1. Unique across the portfolio.

stage.description: Stage id; the Stage issue lives in MianliWang/gatebraid.

phase.description: Phase id; the Phase issue lives in MianliWang/gatebraid.

issue.description: owner/repo#number of the predecessor Slice issue, e.g. MianliWang/gatebraid-scratch#3.

requires_gate.description: Gate the predecessor must have completed. 3 → metadata AND native blocked-by (ADR-0007). 1|2 → metadata only, frontier-computed; never a native dependency.

write_domains.description: Repo-relative path prefixes the frozen Gate-1 allowlist will cover. Empty array = a read-only slice.

repair_limit.description: Maximum repair attempts before Human Diagnosis Required (ADR-0002 §4).

consult_first.description: true moves the Codex consult before repair 1.

parallel_mode.description: isolated-write is RESERVED (v1.1+; per-slice, separately approved; ADR-0003 §6). v1 slices use safe-single-writer.
